author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Who is L.I.M.E?
L.I.M.E is a group formed by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman. We work on maps together and release then under little "packs" for whenever we have time. They will be from a range of many gamemodes -- not just Nebula or Nexus. We will not have exact focuses on what we make, however the end result is usually good. We want to provide unique maps, and with our ideas we want to create a funner Avicus. This time it is pretty simple, but we have released 5 maps under our name. This isn't to say we won't work solo, however think of it as an alias for when we co-author.

What maps are these?
If the images are broken;
[CTW] JungleWool by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman (don't hype, just if it comes around it's here.)
[TDM] Cold City by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman
[TDM] The Maze by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman
[Nexus] The Garden by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman
[Chroma] Tanpopo by ParaSpider and TheHoopsman

Where are the images?
JungleWool - TBA
Cold City - http://imgur.com/a/IFHfI
The Maze - http://imgur.com/a/eLh7K
The Garden - http://imgur.com/a/qeC5Z
Tanpopo - http://imgur.com/a/wCJ5y

Where are the downloads?
Not yet, but they're done and ready.

By the way, Cold City is amazing. Had a lot of fun with that one! And thanks to Evocal for helping on Jungle Wool.
